subject: general
question: Who was the most expensive player at the Indian Premier League (IPL) auction 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ishan Kishan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Indian Premier League (IPL) 2022:

 
 
• It was the 15th edition of the Indian Premier League.
 
• In this edition, Gujarat Titans defeated Rajasthan Royals by 7 wickets.
 
• The franchise is owned by CVC Capital Partners.
 
• The team played under the captaincy of Hardik Pandya and is coached by Ashish Nehra.
 
• It was the maiden IPL for the Gujarat Titans.
 
• The final match took place at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad. 
 
• Jos Buttler was given the Orange Cap in the Indian Premier League 2022.
 
• Yuzvendra Chahal was given the Purple Cap.
 
• Gujarat Titans and Rajasthan Royals were given the Fairplay Award.
